prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1478; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with a collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE] at an intersection where your insured turned left across the path of our client's vehicle. The facts of the collision place responsibility squarely on your insured. Our client had the right of way, was traveling lawfully, and had no reasonable opportunity to avoid the impact.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a significant whiplash injury to the neck and upper back. Symptoms have included persistent neck pain, reduced range of motion, headaches, and muscle spasms that have interfered with daily activities and work. Our client has followed medical advice, attended physical therapy, and continues to experience limitations that may not fully resolve.

The medical documentation, treatment records, and wage information supporting these damages are available and will be provided upon request. We note that the cost of care, lost income, and pain and suffering all continue to accrue.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to settle this claim in full. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office.
